# 2026-11-19 v6.6 D2 phases 4 and 5 (the monastic lands, the council of 1368, the random pool: events 42, 70-72, 90-94; Rus' and the union: events 58, 59) added to this file by the same generator.

# Any scope. Imperial Authority $amount$ (negative = a cost), kept within 0-100.
oe_ecc_auth = {
    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
        change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = $amount$ }
        clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 }
    }
}

# Any scope. Saves oe_ecc_byz_ap (Constantinople's church, led by BYZ), oe_ecc_pec_ap and oe_ecc_pec_lord (Serbia's church and its leader), oe_ecc_tarnovo_ap, and oe_ecc_patriarch (the author's patriarch: the BYZ character with oe_byz_religion_leader; else the organisation's var:patriarch). Missing ones stay unset.
oe_ecc_save_scopes = {
    c:BYZ ?= {
        random_international_organizations_member_of = {
            limit = { oe_ecc_is_byz_ap = yes }
            save_scope_as = oe_ecc_byz_ap
        }
    }
    random_international_organization = { limit = { oe_ecc_is_pec_ap = yes } save_scope_as = oe_ecc_pec_ap }
    scope:oe_ecc_pec_ap ?= { leader_country ?= { save_scope_as = oe_ecc_pec_lord } }
    random_international_organization = { limit = { oe_ecc_is_tarnovo_ap = yes } save_scope_as = oe_ecc_tarnovo_ap }
    if = {
        limit = {
            country_exists = c:BYZ
            c:BYZ = { any_character = { has_character_modifier = oe_byz_religion_leader } }
        }
        c:BYZ = {
            random_character = {
                limit = { has_character_modifier = oe_byz_religion_leader }
                save_scope_as = oe_ecc_patriarch
            }
        }
    }
    else = { scope:oe_ecc_byz_ap ?= { var:patriarch ?= { save_scope_as = oe_ecc_patriarch } } }
}

# Any scope; scope:oe_ecc_byz_ap saved. scope:$who$ joins Constantinople's church (vanilla's on_joined takes it out of any other) and Byzantium likes it a little more: vanilla's auto_leave_trigger drops a member when the leader's opinion of it falls below -50.
oe_ecc_join_byz_ap = {
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_ecc_byz_ap exists = scope:$who$ scope:$who$ = { oe_ecc_in_byz_ap = no } }
        scope:oe_ecc_byz_ap = { add_country_to_international_organization = scope:$who$ }
        c:BYZ = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ecc_flock_returned target = scope:$who$ } }
    }
}

# Any scope; scope:oe_ecc_byz_ap saved. Moves the Orthodox members of scope:$ap$ into Constantinople's church first, then dissolves scope:$ap$ (if it is still there), so vanilla's on_disband has no member left to send elsewhere. A second pass picks up a member that could not move while it led scope:$ap$.
oe_ecc_absorb_ap = {
    scope:$ap$ ?= {
        every_international_organization_member = {
            limit = { religion = religion:orthodox NOT = { tag = BYZ } }
            add_to_list = oe_ecc_flock
        }
    }
    every_in_list = {
        list = oe_ecc_flock
        save_scope_as = oe_ecc_one
        c:BYZ = { oe_ecc_join_byz_ap = { who = oe_ecc_one } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:$ap$ }
        destroy_international_organization_no_instigator = { target = scope:$ap$ reason = oe_ecc_merged_reason }
    }
    every_in_list = {
        list = oe_ecc_flock
        limit = { oe_ecc_stray = yes oe_ecc_leads_an_ap = no }
        save_scope_as = oe_ecc_one
        c:BYZ = { oe_ecc_join_byz_ap = { who = oe_ecc_one } }
    }
}

# Any scope; scope:oe_ecc_byz_ap saved. c:$tag$ joins Constantinople's church if it is Orthodox, outside it and leads no church of its own.
oe_ecc_join_stray = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = scope:oe_ecc_byz_ap
            country_exists = c:$tag$
            c:$tag$ = { oe_ecc_stray = yes oe_ecc_leads_an_ap = no }
        }
        c:$tag$ = { save_scope_as = oe_ecc_one }
        oe_ecc_join_byz_ap = { who = oe_ecc_one }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. Records which side the author's 1341 council (john_war.8) took, in oe_ecc_hesy: 1 Palamas (a: Barlaam leaves the empire), 2 Barlaam (b: Palamas is removed). Twelve months after the council with Palamas still alive and Barlaam still ours, it counts as a. Reads only; D2 and L5 use oe_ecc_hesy.
oe_ecc_hesy_snapshot = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = john_war_8_has_on NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_hesy } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_hesy_seen } }
            set_variable = oe_ecc_hesy_seen
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_hesy_wait months = 12 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { character:byz_gregory_palamas ?= { is_alive = yes } } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_hesy value = 2 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { character:byz_barlaam_of_seminara ?= { is_alive = yes NOT = { owner ?= c:BYZ } } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_hesy value = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_hesy_wait } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_hesy value = 1 }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly from 1360. oe_ecc_serbia_void / oe_ecc_tarnovo_void: 2 = Byzantium no longer leads Constantinople's church; 1 = the question never came (Serbia: see oe_ecc_serbia_lapsed; Tarnovo: 1430). While the house of Osman has joined the empire (oe_osman_chain_active) .3 only waits.
oe_ecc_mark_void = {
    if = {
        limit = { current_date >= 1360.1.1 }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_serbia } NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_serbia_void } }
            if = { limit = { oe_ecc_byz_ecumenical = no } set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_serbia_void value = 2 } }
            else_if = {
                limit = { oe_ecc_serbia_lapsed = yes }
                set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_serbia_void value = 1 }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_tarnovo } NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_tarnovo_void } }
            if = { limit = { oe_ecc_byz_ecumenical = no } set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_tarnovo_void value = 2 } }
            else_if = {
                limit = { current_date >= 1430.1.1 NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_done_3 } }
                set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_tarnovo_void value = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Sends oe_ecc.$n$ if its trigger holds: marks it done, takes the main-line month (line 14) so no other church or main-line event follows this month.
oe_ecc_fire = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ecc_ev_ok_$n$ = yes }
        set_variable = oe_ecc_done_$n$
        oe_ml_take_as = { line = 14 }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ecc.$n$
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly until oe_ecc_p1_closed. Rolls the three events (one a month at most: oe_ecc_fire takes the lock), marks void questions, closes phase 1.
oe_ecc_p1_monthly = {
    if = { limit = { oe_ecc_ok_1 = yes oe_ml_free = yes } random = { chance = 4 oe_ecc_fire = { n = 1 } } }
    if = { limit = { oe_ecc_ok_2 = yes oe_ml_free = yes } random = { chance = 3 oe_ecc_fire = { n = 2 } } }
    if = { limit = { oe_ecc_ok_3 = yes oe_ml_free = yes } random = { chance = 8 oe_ecc_fire = { n = 3 } } }
    oe_ecc_mark_void = yes
    if = { limit = { oe_ecc_p1_settled = yes } set_variable = oe_ecc_p1_closed }
}

# Any scope; scope:oe_ecc_pec_lord saved. oe_ecc_envoy: Lazar Hrebeljanović while alive and in that country's service, else its ruler or regent, else any of its characters.
oe_ecc_save_envoy = {
    scope:oe_ecc_pec_lord ?= {
        if = {
            limit = { character:ser_lazar_hrebeljanovic ?= { is_alive = yes owner ?= scope:oe_ecc_pec_lord } }
            character:ser_lazar_hrebeljanovic = { save_scope_as = oe_ecc_envoy }
        }
        else_if = { limit = { exists = ruler_or_regent } ruler_or_regent = { save_scope_as = oe_ecc_envoy } }
        else = { random_character = { save_scope_as = oe_ecc_envoy } }
    }
}

}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. Serbia founds its own church seated at Peć (or its capital), as vanilla flavor_ser.31 a does: leaves its church, creates one, leads it, default policies.
oe_ecc_test_make_pec = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:SER NOT = { oe_ecc_pec_ap_exists = yes } }
        c:SER = {
            every_international_organizations_member_of = {
                limit = {
                    international_organization_type = international_organization_type:autocephalous_patriarchate
                }
                remove_country_from_international_organization = c:SER
            }
            create_international_organization = {
                type = international_organization_type:autocephalous_patriarchate
                add_country_to_international_organization = prev
                set_leader_country = prev
                save_scope_as = oe_ecc_new_ap
            }
        }
        scope:oe_ecc_new_ap ?= {
            if = { limit = { c:SER = { owns = location:peja } } set_variable = { name = seat value = location:peja } }
            else = { set_variable = { name = seat value = c:SER.capital } }
            apply_independent_patriarchate_default_policies = yes
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Brings the three shares back to whole numbers that add up to 100 (none below 0). FX17: both branches test has_variable = oe_ecc_tot, because a tooltip preview does not apply set_variable (r15: 2250 errors from hovering the synod action).
oe_ecc_norm = {
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_ecc_hes min = 0 max = 1000 }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_ecc_rat min = 0 max = 1000 }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_ecc_uni min = 0 max = 1000 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_tot value = var:oe_ecc_hes }
    change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_tot add = var:oe_ecc_rat }
    change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_tot add = var:oe_ecc_uni }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ecc_tot var:oe_ecc_tot > 0 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_hes multiply = 100 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_hes divide = var:oe_ecc_tot }
        round_variable = { name = oe_ecc_hes nearest = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_rat multiply = 100 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_rat divide = var:oe_ecc_tot }
        round_variable = { name = oe_ecc_rat nearest = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_uni value = 100 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_uni subtract = var:oe_ecc_hes }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_uni subtract = var:oe_ecc_rat }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_ecc_uni < 0 }
            change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_rat add = var:oe_ecc_uni }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_uni value = 0 }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ecc_tot }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_hes value = 45 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_rat value = 40 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_uni value = 15 }
    }
    remove_variable = oe_ecc_tot
}

# BYZ scope. Interface (design 4.2): moves the shares by $hes$ / $rat$ / $uni$ points and brings them back to 100. Does nothing before the framework starts. Other lines change the parties only through this.
oe_ecc_shift = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ecc_hes }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_hes add = $hes$ }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_rat add = $rat$ }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_uni add = $uni$ }
        oe_ecc_norm = yes
    }
}

# BYZ scope. The prevailing party's modifier, and only that one.
oe_ecc_set_dom_modifier = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ecc_dom ?= 1 NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_ecc_dom_hes } }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ecc_dom_hes years = -1 mode = add }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:oe_ecc_dom ?= 1 } has_country_modifier = oe_ecc_dom_hes }
        remove_country_modifier = oe_ecc_dom_hes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ecc_dom ?= 2 NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_ecc_dom_rat } }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ecc_dom_rat years = -1 mode = add }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:oe_ecc_dom ?= 2 } has_country_modifier = oe_ecc_dom_rat }
        remove_country_modifier = oe_ecc_dom_rat
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ecc_dom ?= 3 NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_ecc_dom_uni } }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ecc_dom_uni years = -1 mode = add }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:oe_ecc_dom ?= 3 } has_country_modifier = oe_ecc_dom_uni }
        remove_country_modifier = oe_ecc_dom_uni
    }
}

# BYZ scope. oe_ecc_dom: the party with 40+ that leads the next by 5+ prevails (1-3); a different party takes over only 8+ ahead (no flicker); else 0. Sets the modifier.
oe_ecc_calc_dom = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ecc_hes >= 40 OR = { AND = { var:oe_ecc_dom ?= 1 oe_ecc_lead_1 >= 5 } oe_ecc_lead_1 >= 8 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_dom value = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ecc_rat >= 40 OR = { AND = { var:oe_ecc_dom ?= 2 oe_ecc_lead_2 >= 5 } oe_ecc_lead_2 >= 8 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_dom value = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ecc_uni >= 40 OR = { AND = { var:oe_ecc_dom ?= 3 oe_ecc_lead_3 >= 5 } oe_ecc_lead_3 >= 8 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_dom value = 3 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_dom value = 0 } }
    oe_ecc_set_dom_modifier = yes
}

# BYZ scope. Standing 70+: oe_ecc_pres_high; below 40: oe_ecc_pres_low.
oe_ecc_pres_mods = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ecc_pres >= 70 NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_ecc_pres_high } }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ecc_pres_high years = -1 mode = add }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:oe_ecc_pres >= 70 } has_country_modifier = oe_ecc_pres_high }
        remove_country_modifier = oe_ecc_pres_high
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ecc_pres < 40 NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_ecc_pres_low } }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ecc_pres_low years = -1 mode = add }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:oe_ecc_pres < 40 } has_country_modifier = oe_ecc_pres_low }
        remove_country_modifier = oe_ecc_pres_low
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Interface (design 4.2): the patriarchate's standing $amount$, kept within 0-100. Does nothing before the framework starts.
oe_ecc_pres_add = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ecc_pres }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_pres add = $amount$ }
        clamp_variable = { name = oe_ecc_pres min = 0 max = 100 }
        oe_ecc_pres_mods = yes
    }
}

# BYZ scope, every January. The standing moves 2 towards oe_ecc_pres_target.
oe_ecc_pres_move = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ecc_pres < oe_ecc_pres_target }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_pres add = 2 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_ecc_pres > oe_ecc_pres_target }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_pres value = oe_ecc_pres_target }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ecc_pres > oe_ecc_pres_target }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_pres add = -2 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_ecc_pres < oe_ecc_pres_target }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_pres value = oe_ecc_pres_target }
        }
    }
    oe_ecc_pres_mods = yes
}

# Any scope. Interface (design 4.2): the see $see$ (rus, lit, wal, mol) gets the code $value$ (0 none, 1 in our care, 2 disputed, 3 autocephalous, 4 broken away). Serbia and Tarnovo are derived, not set.
oe_ecc_see_set = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_ecc_see_$see$ value = $value$ }
}

# BYZ scope. oe_ecc_rus_host: Moscow if it is Orthodox and in Constantinople's church, else the most populous Rus' country (the author's oe_rus_country) that is (design 3.3). May stay unset.
oe_ecc_save_rus_host = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:MOS c:MOS = { religion = religion:orthodox oe_ecc_in_byz_ap = yes } }
        c:MOS = { save_scope_as = oe_ecc_rus_host }
    }
    else = {
        ordered_country = {
            limit = { oe_rus_country = yes religion = religion:orthodox oe_ecc_in_byz_ap = yes }
            order_by = total_population
            max = 1
            save_scope_as = oe_ecc_rus_host
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, every January. Serbia and Tarnovo from the organisations and phase 1's outcomes (design 3.3); Rus' becomes autocephalous (3) once the author's action granted its host an autocephalous metropolitan (oe_rus_metropolitan_granted), unless it broke away.
oe_ecc_see_derive = {
    oe_ecc_save_scopes = yes
    if = { limit = { var:oe_ecc_serbia ?= 1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ecc_see_ser value = 3 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_ecc_serbia ?= 2 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ecc_see_ser value = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_ecc_serbia ?= 3 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ecc_see_ser value = 4 } }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_ecc_pec_ap_exists = yes oe_ecc_anathema_on = yes }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ecc_see_ser value = 4 }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_ecc_pec_ap_exists = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ecc_see_ser value = 2 } }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:SER c:SER = { oe_ecc_in_byz_ap = yes } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ecc_see_ser value = 3 }
    }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_ecc_see_ser value = 0 } }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { var:oe_ecc_tarnovo ?= 1 var:oe_ecc_tarnovo ?= 2 } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ecc_see_tar value = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { OR = { var:oe_ecc_tarnovo ?= 3 oe_ecc_tarnovo_ap_exists = yes } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ecc_see_tar value = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                AND = { country_exists = c:BUL c:BUL = { oe_ecc_in_byz_ap = yes } }
                AND = { country_exists = c:VID c:VID = { oe_ecc_in_byz_ap = yes } }
            }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ecc_see_tar value = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_ecc_see_tar value = 0 } }
    oe_ecc_save_rus_host = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            scope:oe_ecc_rus_host ?= { has_variable = oe_rus_metropolitan_granted }
            NOT = { AND = { has_global_variable = oe_ecc_see_rus global_var:oe_ecc_see_rus = 4 } }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ecc_see_rus value = 3 }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. The framework's reaction to oe_ecc.1: standing +5 (recognised; hesychasts +2, the Athonite go-betweens), +8 (Peć stepped down), -3 (refused twice).
oe_ecc_react_serbia = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ecc_serbia ?= 1 }
        oe_ecc_pres_add = { amount = 5 }
        oe_ecc_shift = { hes = 2 rat = 0 uni = 0 }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_ecc_serbia ?= 2 } oe_ecc_pres_add = { amount = 8 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_ecc_serbia ?= 3 } oe_ecc_pres_add = { amount = -3 } }
}

# BYZ scope. The framework's reaction to oe_ecc.2: standing +2 when Vidin was received.
oe_ecc_react_vidin = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_ecc_vidin ?= 1 } oe_ecc_pres_add = { amount = 2 } }
}

# BYZ scope. The framework's reaction to oe_ecc.3: standing +5 (Greek bishops), +4 (Slavonic rite kept; hesychasts +2, Euthymius's school), nothing when Tarnovo stood.
oe_ecc_react_tarnovo = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_ecc_tarnovo ?= 1 } oe_ecc_pres_add = { amount = 5 } }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ecc_tarnovo ?= 2 }
        oe_ecc_pres_add = { amount = 4 }
        oe_ecc_shift = { hes = 2 rat = 0 uni = 0 }
    }
}

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_ecc_pat saved. Vanilla's record follows the author's patriarch: the organisation's var:patriarch (set_patriarch_variables; the one it replaces loses is_patriarch) and, with D008, the Constantinople seat of religion:orthodox's pentarchy map and is_pentarch (as character_death_pulses.txt does it).
oe_ecc_pat_sync = {
    random_international_organizations_member_of = {
        limit = { oe_ecc_is_byz_ap = yes }
        save_scope_as = oe_ecc_byz_ap
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = scope:oe_ecc_byz_ap
            exists = scope:oe_ecc_pat
            NOT = { scope:oe_ecc_byz_ap = { var:patriarch ?= { this = scope:oe_ecc_pat } } }
        }
        scope:oe_ecc_byz_ap = {
            var:patriarch ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = is_patriarch } remove_variable = is_patriarch } }
        }
        set_patriarch_variables = { organization = scope:oe_ecc_byz_ap character = scope:oe_ecc_pat }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_dlc = "d008_fate_of_the_phoenix"
            exists = scope:oe_ecc_pat
            NOT = { scope:oe_ecc_pat = { var:is_pentarch ?= location:constantinople } }
        }
        religion:orthodox = {
            every_key_in_variable_map = {
                variable = pentarchy
                limit = { this = location:constantinople }
                save_scope_as = oe_ecc_pseat
                c:BYZ = {
                    every_character = {
                        limit = { var:is_pentarch ?= location:constantinople NOT = { this = scope:oe_ecc_pat } }
                        remove_variable = is_pentarch
                    }
                }
                religion:orthodox = {
                    remove_from_variable_map = { name = pentarchy key = scope:oe_ecc_pseat }
                    add_to_variable_map = { name = pentarchy key = scope:oe_ecc_pseat value = scope:oe_ecc_pat }
                }
                scope:oe_ecc_pat = { set_pentarch_variable = { location = scope:oe_ecc_pseat } }
            }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. The patriarch (ours, with the author's oe_byz_religion_leader) gets a party the first time we see that character: Kalekas rationalist (design 6.12); born on Mount Athos (the author's .403 c) hesychast; in the cabinet (.403 b) rationalist, unionist during union talks; else (.403 a) the prevailing party, hesychast when none prevails. Records oe_ecc_pat_f and oe_ecc_pat_last and syncs vanilla's record; oe_ecc_pat_f = 0 while the see is empty.
oe_ecc_pat_check = {
    random_character = { limit = { has_character_modifier = oe_byz_religion_leader } save_scope_as = oe_ecc_pat }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_ecc_pat }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_ecc_pat = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_f } } }
            if = {
                limit = { character:byz_john_xiv_kalekas ?= { this = scope:oe_ecc_pat } }
                scope:oe_ecc_pat = { set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_f value = 2 } }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:oe_ecc_pat = { birth_location ?= location:mount_athos } }
                scope:oe_ecc_pat = { set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_f value = 1 } }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:oe_ecc_pat = { in_cabinet = yes } oe_ecc_union_talks = yes }
                scope:oe_ecc_pat = { set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_f value = 3 } }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:oe_ecc_pat = { in_cabinet = yes } }
                scope:oe_ecc_pat = { set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_f value = 2 } }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:oe_ecc_dom ?= 2 }
                scope:oe_ecc_pat = { set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_f value = 2 } }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:oe_ecc_dom ?= 3 }
                scope:oe_ecc_pat = { set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_f value = 3 } }
            }
            else = { scope:oe_ecc_pat = { set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_f value = 1 } } }
        }
        if = { limit = { scope:oe_ecc_pat = { var:oe_ecc_f ?= 1 } } set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_pat_f value = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { scope:oe_ecc_pat = { var:oe_ecc_f ?= 2 } } set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_pat_f value = 2 } }
        if = { limit = { scope:oe_ecc_pat = { var:oe_ecc_f ?= 3 } } set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_pat_f value = 3 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_pat_last value = scope:oe_ecc_pat }
        oe_ecc_pat_sync = yes
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_pat_f value = 0 } }
}

# BYZ scope. Interface (design 4.2): the see falls vacant without a death. The patriarch loses the author's oe_byz_religion_leader (so a later death does not start oe_flavor_byz.403 again) and vanilla's is_patriarch, and retires to a monastery alive. oe_ecc_vacancy = $reason$: 1-6 a new ruler (.32), 7 union (L4, phase 5), 8 union set aside (L4's .21 c), 9 test page, 33 the refused crown (.33), 40 the council of 1347 (.40). .30 follows in the monthly round; every party puts up a candidate unless the caller narrows them (oe_ecc_offer_emp, or oe_ecc_offer_party from phase 5). One vacancy at a time.
oe_ecc_vacate = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_vacancy } }
        every_character = {
            limit = { has_character_modifier = oe_byz_religion_leader }
            remove_character_modifier = oe_byz_religion_leader
            if = { limit = { has_variable = is_patriarch } remove_variable = is_patriarch }
            set_variable = oe_ecc_retired
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_vacancy value = $reason$ }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_pat_f value = 0 }
        set_variable = oe_ecc_offer_1
        set_variable = oe_ecc_offer_2
        set_variable = oe_ecc_offer_3
    }
}

# BYZ scope, after oe_ecc_vacate (.32 a). Candidates of the new ruler's party (oe_ecc_emp_f) and of the largest party; when that is the same party, also of the larger of the other two (design .32 a).
oe_ecc_offer_emp = {
    remove_variable = oe_ecc_offer_1
    remove_variable = oe_ecc_offer_2
    remove_variable = oe_ecc_offer_3
    set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_top value = oe_ecc_top_f }
    if = { limit = { OR = { var:oe_ecc_emp_f ?= 1 var:oe_ecc_top ?= 1 } } set_variable = oe_ecc_offer_1 }
    if = { limit = { OR = { var:oe_ecc_emp_f ?= 2 var:oe_ecc_top ?= 2 } } set_variable = oe_ecc_offer_2 }
    if = { limit = { OR = { var:oe_ecc_emp_f ?= 3 var:oe_ecc_top ?= 3 } } set_variable = oe_ecc_offer_3 }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ecc_emp_f ?= 1 var:oe_ecc_top ?= 1 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_ecc_rat >= var:oe_ecc_uni } set_variable = oe_ecc_offer_2 }
        else = { set_variable = oe_ecc_offer_3 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ecc_emp_f ?= 2 var:oe_ecc_top ?= 2 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_ecc_hes >= var:oe_ecc_uni } set_variable = oe_ecc_offer_1 }
        else = { set_variable = oe_ecc_offer_3 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ecc_emp_f ?= 3 var:oe_ecc_top ?= 3 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_ecc_hes >= var:oe_ecc_rat } set_variable = oe_ecc_offer_1 }
        else = { set_variable = oe_ecc_offer_2 }
    }
    remove_variable = oe_ecc_top
}

# BYZ scope (.31). The chosen candidate comes to the empire as patriarch (the author's oe_byz_religion_leader, so the author's death hook works for them later; not the author's three country modifiers, those belong to oe_flavor_byz.403); the others go back to their monasteries (removed silently).
oe_ecc_install = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ecc_pick ?= 1 }
        var:oe_ecc_cand_1 ?= { save_scope_as = oe_ecc_new }
        remove_variable = oe_ecc_cand_1
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ecc_pick ?= 2 }
        var:oe_ecc_cand_2 ?= { save_scope_as = oe_ecc_new }
        remove_variable = oe_ecc_cand_2
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ecc_pick ?= 3 }
        var:oe_ecc_cand_3 ?= { save_scope_as = oe_ecc_new }
        remove_variable = oe_ecc_cand_3
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_ecc_new }
        scope:oe_ecc_new = {
            move_country = c:BYZ
            remove_variable = oe_ecc_cand
            add_character_modifier = { modifier = oe_byz_religion_leader mode = add_and_extend days = -1 }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ecc_cand_1 }
        var:oe_ecc_cand_1 ?= { kill_character_silently = this }
        remove_variable = oe_ecc_cand_1
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ecc_cand_2 }
        var:oe_ecc_cand_2 ?= { kill_character_silently = this }
        remove_variable = oe_ecc_cand_2
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ecc_cand_3 }
        var:oe_ecc_cand_3 ?= { kill_character_silently = this }
        remove_variable = oe_ecc_cand_3
    }
    remove_variable = oe_ecc_vacancy
    remove_variable = oe_ecc_vac_open
    remove_variable = oe_ecc_pick
    remove_variable = oe_ecc_offer_1
    remove_variable = oe_ecc_offer_2
    remove_variable = oe_ecc_offer_3
    oe_ecc_pat_check = yes
}

# BYZ scope. oe_ecc_emp_f, the party the new ruler favours: Kantakouzenos (reason 1) the hesychasts; during union talks the unionists; else the larger of the two parties the sitting patriarch is not of (the largest party when the see is empty).
oe_ecc_emp_pick = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_ecc_dep_reason ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_emp_f value = 1 } }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_ecc_union_talks = yes NOT = { var:oe_ecc_pat_f ?= 3 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_emp_f value = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ecc_pat_f ?= 1 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_ecc_rat >= var:oe_ecc_uni } set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_emp_f value = 2 } }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_emp_f value = 3 } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ecc_pat_f ?= 2 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_ecc_hes >= var:oe_ecc_uni } set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_emp_f value = 1 } }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_emp_f value = 3 } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ecc_pat_f ?= 3 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_ecc_hes >= var:oe_ecc_rat } set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_emp_f value = 1 } }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_emp_f value = 2 } }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_emp_f value = oe_ecc_top_f } }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. Finds a reason for .32 (design 3.6): the first sight of a reason's flag makes it fresh for 3 months; a change of ruler while it is fresh gives the reason (1 Kantakouzenos, 2 the usurper, 3 the restoration, 6 the end of the 1352 war); the emperor leaving for the West (C7) gives 5 without a change of ruler. Each reason once; an ordinary succession gives none. Drops a reason that no longer applies.
oe_ecc_emp_check = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_cw_kantakouzenos_won NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_seen_1 } }
        set_variable = oe_ecc_seen_1
        set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_fresh_1 months = 3 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_vas_usurped NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_seen_2 } }
        set_variable = oe_ecc_seen_2
        set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_fresh_2 months = 3 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_vas_restored NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_seen_3 } }
        set_variable = oe_ecc_seen_3
        set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_fresh_3 months = 3 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_j7_usurped NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_seen_4 } }
        set_variable = oe_ecc_seen_4
        set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_fresh_4 months = 3 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_byd_west ?= 1 NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_seen_5 } }
        set_variable = oe_ecc_seen_5
        set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_fresh_5 months = 3 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_cw2_done NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_seen_6 } }
        set_variable = oe_ecc_seen_6
        set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_fresh_6 months = 3 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:oe_ecc_emp ?= { is_ruler_of = c:BYZ } } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_dep_reason } }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_ecc_fresh_1 NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_dep_1 } }
                set_variable = oe_ecc_dep_1
                set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_dep_reason value = 1 }
                oe_ecc_emp_pick = yes
                if = { limit = { oe_ecc_emp_same = yes } remove_variable = oe_ecc_dep_reason }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_ecc_fresh_2 NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_dep_2 } }
                set_variable = oe_ecc_dep_2
                set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_dep_reason value = 2 }
                oe_ecc_emp_pick = yes
                if = { limit = { oe_ecc_emp_same = yes } remove_variable = oe_ecc_dep_reason }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_ecc_fresh_3 NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_dep_3 } }
                set_variable = oe_ecc_dep_3
                set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_dep_reason value = 3 }
                oe_ecc_emp_pick = yes
                if = { limit = { oe_ecc_emp_same = yes } remove_variable = oe_ecc_dep_reason }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_ecc_fresh_4 NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_dep_4 } }
                set_variable = oe_ecc_dep_4
                set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_dep_reason value = 4 }
                oe_ecc_emp_pick = yes
                if = { limit = { oe_ecc_emp_same = yes } remove_variable = oe_ecc_dep_reason }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_ecc_fresh_6 NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_dep_6 } }
                set_variable = oe_ecc_dep_6
                set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_dep_reason value = 6 }
                oe_ecc_emp_pick = yes
                if = { limit = { oe_ecc_emp_same = yes } remove_variable = oe_ecc_dep_reason }
            }
        }
        ruler ?= { save_scope_as = oe_ecc_ruler }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_ecc_ruler }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_emp value = scope:oe_ecc_ruler }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = oe_ecc_fresh_5
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_dep_5 }
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_dep_reason }
        }
        set_variable = oe_ecc_dep_5
        set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_dep_reason value = 5 }
        oe_ecc_emp_pick = yes
        if = { limit = { oe_ecc_emp_same = yes } remove_variable = oe_ecc_dep_reason }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = oe_ecc_dep_reason
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_dep_open }
            OR = { has_variable = oe_ecc_vacancy AND = { var:oe_ecc_dep_reason ?= 1 var:oe_ecc_c40 ?= 1 } }
        }
        remove_variable = oe_ecc_dep_reason
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. Matthew Kantakouzenos is crowned in the 1352 war (oe_cw2_mat_crowned): a patriarch who is not a hesychast refuses (.33); a hesychast refuses half the time (Kallistos did). Once.
oe_ecc_crown_check = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = oe_cw2_mat_crowned
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_done_33 }
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_crown_due }
            oe_ecc_has_pat = yes
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_vacancy }
        }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { var:oe_ecc_pat_f ?= 1 } } set_variable = oe_ecc_crown_due }
        else = {
            random_list = {
                50 = { set_variable = oe_ecc_crown_due }
                50 = { set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_done_33 value = 2 } }
            }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. Marks the historical events whose window has passed (oe_ecc_done_<n> = 2): .40 from 1352; .41 from 1362 or when .40 never came; .33 when the 1352 war ended without a crowning, or from 1360.
oe_ecc_windows = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_done_40 } current_date >= 1352.1.1 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_done_40 value = 2 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_done_41 } OR = { current_date >= 1362.1.1 var:oe_ecc_done_40 ?= 2 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_done_41 value = 2 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_done_33 }
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_crown_due }
            OR = {
                current_date >= 1360.1.1
                AND = { has_global_variable = oe_cw2_done NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw2_mat_crowned } }
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_done_33 value = 2 }
    }
}

# BYZ scope (.20, test page). Sets the framework up (design 3.3, .20): shares 45/40/15 moved by the 1341 council (oe_ecc_hesy), vanilla's flavor_byz.1100 and Barlaam's embassy to Avignon (oe_s7_avignon_1339); the prevailing party; standing 50; monasteries 3 (phase 4 reads it); the sees; phase 1's outcomes so far; the patriarch's party; the ruler and the reasons already seen (not fresh). .21 a month later.
oe_ecc_init = {
    set_variable = oe_ecc_on
    remove_variable = oe_ecc_init_sent
    set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_hes value = 45 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_rat value = 40 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_uni value = 15 }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ecc_hesy ?= 1 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_hes add = 10 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_rat add = -10 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ecc_hesy ?= 2 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_hes add = -15 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_rat add = 15 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_modifier = promoted_hesychastic_influences_modifier }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_hes add = 5 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_rat add = -5 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_country_modifier = suppressed_hesychastic_influences_modifier }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_hes add = -5 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_rat add = 5 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_s7_avignon_1339 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_uni add = 5 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_rat add = -5 }
    }
    oe_ecc_norm = yes
    set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_pres value = 50 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_mon } } set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_mon value = 3 } }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ecc_see_rus } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ecc_see_rus value = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ecc_see_lit } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ecc_see_lit value = 0 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ecc_see_wal } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ecc_see_wal value = 0 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ecc_see_mol } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ecc_see_mol value = 0 }
    }
    oe_ecc_react_serbia = yes
    oe_ecc_react_vidin = yes
    oe_ecc_react_tarnovo = yes
    oe_ecc_calc_dom = yes
    oe_ecc_see_derive = yes
    oe_ecc_pres_mods = yes
    oe_ecc_pat_check = yes
    ruler ?= { save_scope_as = oe_ecc_ruler }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_ecc_ruler } set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_emp value = scope:oe_ecc_ruler } }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_cw_kantakouzenos_won } set_variable = oe_ecc_seen_1 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_vas_usurped } set_variable = oe_ecc_seen_2 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_vas_restored } set_variable = oe_ecc_seen_3 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_j7_usurped } set_variable = oe_ecc_seen_4 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_byd_west ?= 1 } set_variable = oe_ecc_seen_5 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_cw2_done } set_variable = oe_ecc_seen_6 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_21_wait months = 1 }
}

# BYZ scope, every January (test page too). The drift of design 3.3, then the prevailing party, Serbia and Tarnovo, the Rus' council's success (+5 once each time), and the standing.
oe_ecc_yearly = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_ecc_pat_f ?= 1 } change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_hes add = 2 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_ecc_pat_f ?= 2 } change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_rat add = 2 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_ecc_pat_f ?= 3 } change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_uni add = 2 } }
    if = {
        limit = { location:mount_athos = { owner ?= c:BYZ } }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_ecc_mon var:oe_ecc_mon >= 2 }
            change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_hes add = 2 }
        }
    }
    else = { change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_hes add = -1 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_ecc_union_talks = yes } change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_uni add = 2 } }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { has_country_modifier = oe_br_union_scandal oe_ecc_union_made = yes } }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_hes add = 2 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_uni add = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { societal_value:latinization_vs_hellenization < -30 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_uni add = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { societal_value:latinization_vs_hellenization > 30 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_hes add = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_vas_begun NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_vas_done } }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_uni add = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ar_council_orthodox NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_ar_1 } }
        set_variable = oe_ecc_ar_1
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_hes add = 10 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ar_council_union NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_ar_2 } }
        set_variable = oe_ecc_ar_2
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_uni add = 15 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ar_council_roman NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_ar_3 } }
        set_variable = oe_ecc_ar_3
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_uni add = 20 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_hes add = 5 }
    }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_ecc_mon ?= 0 } change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_hes add = -3 } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_ecc_hes > 60 } change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_hes add = -2 } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_ecc_rat > 60 } change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_rat add = -2 } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_ecc_uni > 60 } change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_uni add = -2 } }
    oe_ecc_norm = yes
    oe_ecc_calc_dom = yes
    oe_ecc_see_derive = yes
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_rsc_success NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_rsc_seen } }
        set_variable = oe_ecc_rsc_seen
        oe_ecc_pres_add = { amount = 5 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_rsc_success } has_variable = oe_ecc_rsc_seen }
        remove_variable = oe_ecc_rsc_seen
    }
    oe_ecc_pres_move = yes
}

# BYZ scope. The framework ends (Constantinople lost, or no longer leading its church): oe_ecc_off; the drift and the checks stop, the variables stay for later lines (N4); the standing and party modifiers go.
oe_ecc_end = {
    set_variable = oe_ecc_off
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ecc_dom_hes } remove_country_modifier = oe_ecc_dom_hes }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ecc_dom_rat } remove_country_modifier = oe_ecc_dom_rat }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ecc_dom_uni } remove_country_modifier = oe_ecc_dom_uni }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ecc_pres_high } remove_country_modifier = oe_ecc_pres_high }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ecc_pres_low } remove_country_modifier = oe_ecc_pres_low }
}

# BYZ scope. Sends oe_ecc.$n$ if its trigger holds and takes the main-line month (line 14). The caller marks one-off events done.
oe_ecc_send = {
    if = { limit = { oe_ecc_ev_ok_$n$ = yes } oe_ml_take_as = { line = 14 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ecc.$n$ }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly while the framework runs (design 3.4 step 7): at most one event. First .30 / .33 / .32 (they wait at most 6 months for the lock), else, when the month is free, .21, .40, .41. Phase 3 adds .50-.82 to the second list, phase 4 the pool .90-.94 after it.
oe_ecc_fw_events = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ecc_urgent = yes }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { oe_ml_free = yes AND = { has_variable = oe_ecc_wait var:oe_ecc_wait >= 6 } } }
            remove_variable = oe_ecc_wait
            if = { limit = { oe_ecc_ok_30 = yes } set_variable = oe_ecc_vac_open oe_ecc_send = { n = 30 } }
            else_if = {
                limit = { oe_ecc_ok_33 = yes }
                remove_variable = oe_ecc_crown_due
                set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_done_33 value = 1 }
                oe_ecc_send = { n = 33 }
            }
            else = { set_variable = oe_ecc_dep_open oe_ecc_send = { n = 32 } }
        }
        else = {
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_wait } } set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_wait value = 0 } }
            change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_wait add = 1 }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_ml_free = yes }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_ecc_ok_21 = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_done_21 value = 1 }
            oe_ecc_send = { n = 21 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_ecc_ok_40 = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_done_40 value = 1 }
            oe_ecc_send = { n = 40 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_ecc_ok_41 = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_done_41 value = 1 }
            oe_ecc_send = { n = 41 }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly (design 3.4 steps 2-5). Not started: the hidden set-up .20 when the start conditions hold. Running: ends the framework when Byzantium no longer leads Constantinople's church; else the January drift, the patriarch, a new ruler, a refused crown and passed windows.
oe_ecc_fw_upkeep = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_on } }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_ecc_fw_start = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_init_sent } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_init_sent months = 2 }
            trigger_event_silently = oe_ecc.20
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_off } }
        if = { limit = { oe_ecc_byz_ecumenical = no } oe_ecc_end = yes }
        else = {
            if = {
                limit = { current_month = 1 NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_yr_cd } }
                set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_yr_cd months = 6 }
                oe_ecc_yearly = yes
            }
            oe_ecc_pat_check = yes
            oe_ecc_emp_check = yes
            oe_ecc_crown_check = yes
            oe_ecc_windows = yes
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope (the action oe_ecc_synod). Costs 5 Imperial Authority and 100 gold, 10 years' cooldown, then .22.
oe_ecc_synod_do = {
    oe_ecc_auth = { amount = -5 }
    add_gold = -100
    set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_synod_cd years = 10 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ecc.22
}

# Any scope. One debug-log line with the framework's state.
oe_ecc_fw_log = {
    debug_log = "OE_ECC fw hes=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_ecc_hes').GetValue|0] rat=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_ecc_rat').GetValue|0] uni=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_ecc_uni').GetValue|0] dom=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_ecc_dom').GetValue|0] patf=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_ecc_pat_f').GetValue|0] synced=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ecc_pat_synced_value')|0] leads=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ecc_leads_ap_value')|0] pres=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_ecc_pres').GetValue|0] rus=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ecc_see_rus_value')|0] lit=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ecc_see_lit_value')|0] wal=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ecc_see_wal_value')|0] mol=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ecc_see_mol_value')|0] ser=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ecc_see_ser_value')|0] tar=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ecc_see_tar_value')|0] mon=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_ecc_mon').GetValue|0] vac=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_ecc_vacancy').GetValue|0] dep=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_ecc_dep_reason').GetValue|0] live=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ecc_live_value')|0]"

oe_ecc_p3_log = {

# BYZ scope, monthly while the framework runs. Ends the timed see codes (.50 c: Rus' disputed for 5 years; .56 a: Lithuania broken away for 6) unless something else changed them meanwhile; marks .50 (from 1365) and .55 (from 1400) passed (oe_ecc_done_<n> = 2); rolls .55's 5% a month.
oe_ecc_p3_upkeep = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ecc_rus_held NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_rus_hold } }
        remove_variable = oe_ecc_rus_held
        if = {
            limit = { AND = { has_global_variable = oe_ecc_see_rus global_var:oe_ecc_see_rus = 2 } }
            oe_ecc_see_set = { see = rus value = 1 }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ecc_lit_held NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_lit_hold } }
        remove_variable = oe_ecc_lit_held
        if = {
            limit = { AND = { has_global_variable = oe_ecc_see_lit global_var:oe_ecc_see_lit = 4 } }
            oe_ecc_see_set = { see = lit value = 1 }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_done_50 } current_date >= 1365.1.1 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_done_50 value = 2 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_done_55 } current_date >= 1400.1.1 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_done_55 value = 2 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_done_55 } current_date >= 1390.1.1 }
        random = { chance = 5 set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_55_roll days = 20 } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly while the framework runs, from April 1353. In a month the main-line lock is still free, sends the first phase-3 event that is due, in number order (.50-.57, .60-.62, .80). Keeps the Rus' host in oe_ecc_rus_host_v for the test page.
oe_ecc_p3_events = {
    if = {
        limit = { current_date >= 1353.4.1 oe_ml_free = yes }
        oe_ecc_save_rus_host = yes

            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_rus_host_v value = scope:oe_ecc_rus_host }
        }
        else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ecc_rus_host_v } remove_variable = oe_ecc_rus_host_v }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_ecc_ok_50 = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_done_50 value = 1 }
            oe_ecc_send = { n = 50 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_ecc_ok_51 = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_done_51 value = 1 }
            oe_ecc_send = { n = 51 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_ecc_ok_52 = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_done_52 value = 1 }
            oe_ecc_send = { n = 52 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_ecc_ok_53 = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_done_53 value = 1 }
            oe_ecc_send = { n = 53 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_ecc_ok_54 = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_done_54 value = 1 }
            oe_ecc_send = { n = 54 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_ecc_ok_55 = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_done_55 value = 1 }
            oe_ecc_send = { n = 55 }

        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_ecc_ok_57 = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_done_57 value = 1 }
            oe_ecc_send = { n = 57 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_ecc_ok_60 = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_done_60 value = 1 }

# BYZ scope, monthly while the framework runs: phase 3's step in oe_ecc_monthly (after phase 2's events, so .30/.32/.33 and .21/.40/.41 come first).
oe_ecc_p3_monthly = {
    oe_ecc_p3_upkeep = yes
    oe_ecc_p3_events = yes
}

# BYZ scope (monthly, and after every change of oe_ecc_mon). The modifier of the level, and only that one; the 10-year clock of .71 starts when the level becomes 1 (oe_ecc_mon1_on, the timed oe_ecc_mon1_t; .71 may come again) and is dropped when it leaves 1. Reads with ?= only: a tooltip preview does not apply the set_variable before it.
oe_ecc_mon_sync = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ecc_mon ?= 3 NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_ecc_mon_3 } }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ecc_mon_3 years = -1 mode = add }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:oe_ecc_mon ?= 3 } has_country_modifier = oe_ecc_mon_3 }
        remove_country_modifier = oe_ecc_mon_3
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ecc_mon ?= 1 NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_ecc_mon_1 } }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ecc_mon_1 years = -1 mode = add }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:oe_ecc_mon ?= 1 } has_country_modifier = oe_ecc_mon_1 }
        remove_country_modifier = oe_ecc_mon_1
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ecc_mon ?= 0 NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_ecc_mon_0 } }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ecc_mon_0 years = -1 mode = add }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:oe_ecc_mon ?= 0 } has_country_modifier = oe_ecc_mon_0 }
        remove_country_modifier = oe_ecc_mon_0
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ecc_mon ?= 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_mon1_on } }
            set_variable = oe_ecc_mon1_on
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_mon1_t years = 10 }
            remove_variable = oe_ecc_done_71
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ecc_mon1_on }
        remove_variable = oe_ecc_mon1_on
        remove_variable = oe_ecc_mon1_t
        remove_variable = oe_ecc_71_once
    }
}

# BYZ scope. The monastic lands go to level $level$ (3 exempt, 2 customary, 1 half held as pronoia, 0 confiscated); the modifiers follow. Nothing before the framework starts.
oe_ecc_mon_to = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ecc_mon }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_mon value = $level$ }
        oe_ecc_mon_sync = yes
    }
}

# BYZ scope (.94 a). The monastic lands go up one level, at most to 3.
oe_ecc_mon_up = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ecc_mon var:oe_ecc_mon <= 2 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_mon add = 1 }
        oe_ecc_mon_sync = yes
    }
}

# BYZ scope (the worker .23, job 2; .70 a). The soldiers settled on the monastic lands: manpower worth 6 months.
oe_ecc_mon_levy = {
    add_manpower = { value = monthly_manpower multiply = 6 }
}

# BYZ scope, right after oe_ecc_vacate. Interface (L4 design 4.3): the synod puts up a candidate of party $f$ (1 hesychasts, 2 rationalists, 3 unionists) and of the largest party; when that is the same party, also of the larger of the other two. It records $f$ as the party the emperor favours (oe_ecc_emp_f) and narrows the candidates as .32 a does (oe_ecc_offer_emp). Nothing without a vacancy.
oe_ecc_offer_party = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ecc_vacancy has_variable = oe_ecc_hes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_emp_f value = $f$ }
        oe_ecc_offer_emp = yes
    }
}

# BYZ scope. One pool event by weight (.91 counts double while the scholars' dispute of .40 b lasts). Sets the pool's cooldown (36 months) and the shared story gap; an event of .90/.91/.92/.94 does not come again for 12 years, .93 comes once.
oe_ecc_pool_dispatch = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_pool_cd months = 36 }
    oe_story_gap_set = yes
    random_list = {
        10 = {
            trigger = { oe_ecc_ok_90 = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_pool_90 years = 12 }
            oe_ecc_send = { n = 90 }
        }
        10 = {
            trigger = { oe_ecc_ok_91 = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_pool_91 years = 12 }
            oe_ecc_send = { n = 91 }
        }
        10 = {
            trigger = { oe_ecc_ok_92 = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_pool_92 years = 12 }
            oe_ecc_send = { n = 92 }
        }
        10 = {
            trigger = { oe_ecc_ok_93 = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_done_93 value = 1 }
            oe_ecc_send = { n = 93 }
        }
        10 = {
            trigger = { oe_ecc_ok_94 = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_pool_94 years = 12 }
            oe_ecc_send = { n = 94 }
        }
        10 = {
            trigger = { oe_ecc_ok_91 = yes has_variable = oe_ecc_dispute_open }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_pool_91 years = 12 }
            oe_ecc_send = { n = 91 }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly while the framework runs. Keeps the modifier of the monastic lands; marks .42 (from 1380) and .70 (from 1400) passed (oe_ecc_done_<n> = 2); keeps oe_ecc_rus2_since, the month the see of Rus' became disputed (removed when it no longer is), for .59.
oe_ecc_p4_upkeep = {
    oe_ecc_mon_sync = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_done_42 } current_date >= 1380.1.1 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_done_42 value = 2 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_done_70 } current_date >= 1400.1.1 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_done_70 value = 2 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { AND = { has_global_variable = oe_ecc_see_rus global_var:oe_ecc_see_rus = 2 } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_rus2_since } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_rus2_since value = oe_ecc_m_now }
        }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ecc_rus2_since } remove_variable = oe_ecc_rus2_since }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly while the framework runs. In a month the main-line lock is still free, sends the first phase-4 or phase-5 event that is due, in number order (.42, .58, .59, .70, .71, .72); else rolls the random pool (3% a month while oe_ecc_pool_ok holds).
oe_ecc_p4_events = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ml_free = yes }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_ecc_ok_42 = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_done_42 value = 1 }
            oe_ecc_send = { n = 42 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_ecc_ok_58 = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_done_58 value = 1 }
            oe_ecc_send = { n = 58 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_ecc_ok_59 = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_done_59 value = 1 }
            oe_ecc_send = { n = 59 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_ecc_ok_70 = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_done_70 value = 1 }
            oe_ecc_send = { n = 70 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_ecc_ok_71 = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_done_71 value = 1 }
            oe_ecc_send = { n = 71 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_ecc_ok_72 = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_done_72 value = 1 }
            oe_ecc_send = { n = 72 }
        }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_ecc_pool_ok = yes } random = { chance = 3 oe_ecc_pool_dispatch = yes } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly while the framework runs: the step of phases 4 and 5 in oe_ecc_monthly (after phase 3's, so the events of phases 2 and 3 come first).
oe_ecc_p4_monthly = {
    oe_ecc_p4_upkeep = yes
    oe_ecc_p4_events = yes
}

# Any scope. One debug-log line with the state of phases 4 and 5.
oe_ecc_p45_log = {
    debug_log = "OE_ECC p45 d42=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_ecc_done_42').GetValue|0] d58=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_ecc_done_58').GetValue|0] d59=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_ecc_done_59').GetValue|0] d70=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_ecc_done_70').GetValue|0] d71=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_ecc_done_71').GetValue|0] d72=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_ecc_done_72').GetValue|0] d93=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_ecc_done_93').GetValue|0] mon=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_ecc_mon').GetValue|0] flags=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ecc_p45_flags')|0] rus=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ecc_see_rus_value')|0] rus2=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ecc_rus2_months')|0] athos=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_emd_athos').GetValue|0] m=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ecc_m_now')|0]"
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. Sends the pool events in turn (.90 to .94, then again), whatever the chance, the cooldowns and the story gap.
oe_ecc_test_pool_next = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_dev_pool } } set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_dev_pool value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_ecc_dev_pool ?= 0 } oe_ecc_send = { n = 90 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_ecc_dev_pool ?= 1 } oe_ecc_send = { n = 91 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_ecc_dev_pool ?= 2 } oe_ecc_send = { n = 92 } }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ecc_dev_pool ?= 3 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_done_93 value = 1 }
        oe_ecc_send = { n = 93 }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_ecc_dev_pool ?= 4 } oe_ecc_send = { n = 94 } }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ecc_dev_pool }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_dev_pool add = 1 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_ecc_dev_pool >= 5 } set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_dev_pool value = 0 } }
    }
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. The monastic lands one level down (3, 2, 1, 0, then 3 again).
oe_ecc_test_mon_cycle = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_ecc_mon ?= 3 } oe_ecc_mon_to = { level = 2 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_ecc_mon ?= 2 } oe_ecc_mon_to = { level = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_ecc_mon ?= 1 } oe_ecc_mon_to = { level = 0 } }
    else = { oe_ecc_mon_to = { level = 3 } }
}

# BYZ scope. Every result of oe_ecc.1: r = 1 recognised, 2 Peć stepped down, 3 refused twice. Phase 1 records it in oe_ecc_serbia; later phases add their reactions after it (AFTER in gen_ecclesia.py).
oe_ecc_after_serbia = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_serbia value = $r$ }
    if = { limit = { oe_ecc_live = yes } oe_ecc_react_serbia = yes }
}

# BYZ scope. Every result of oe_ecc.2: r = 1 received, 2 declined. Phase 1 records it in oe_ecc_vidin; later phases add their reactions after it (AFTER in gen_ecclesia.py).
oe_ecc_after_vidin = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_vidin value = $r$ }
    if = { limit = { oe_ecc_live = yes } oe_ecc_react_vidin = yes }
}

# BYZ scope. Every result of oe_ecc.3: r = 1 Greek bishops, 2 Slavonic rite kept, 3 the see of Tarnovo left standing. Phase 1 records it in oe_ecc_tarnovo; later phases add their reactions after it (AFTER in gen_ecclesia.py).
oe_ecc_after_tarnovo = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_tarnovo value = $r$ }
    if = { limit = { oe_ecc_live = yes } oe_ecc_react_tarnovo = yes }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly: called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py LINES, id 14 "ecc"); no hook of its own. Steps in order (MONTHLY in gen_ecclesia.py).
oe_ecc_monthly = {
    oe_ecc_hesy_snapshot = yes
    oe_ecc_fw_upkeep = yes
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_p1_closed } } oe_ecc_p1_monthly = yes }
    if = { limit = { oe_ecc_live = yes } oe_ecc_fw_events = yes }
    if = { limit = { oe_ecc_live = yes } oe_ecc_p3_monthly = yes }
    if = { limit = { oe_ecc_live = yes } oe_ecc_p4_monthly = yes }
}
